from: July book, night 12 (Naaman Washes Seven Times)
p1: Naaman led the soldiers of a land called Syria. But he had a sickness on his skin.
A little girl from Israel helped Naaman’s wife. She said, “I wish Naaman could see the prophet in Israel! He would heal him.”
So Naaman came to Elisha’s door. Elisha sent word: “Wash in the Jordan River seven times. Then you will be clean.”
p2: Naaman was angry and went away. He wanted Elisha to do something grand. His helpers said, “If the prophet asked a big thing, you would do it!” So Naaman washed seven times. His skin became soft, like a little child’s!
Jesus told about Naaman too. Small choices to obey can bring big blessings. Tomorrow, do one small thing your grown-up asks.
old: Naaman was a strong, important soldier. But he was very sick with sores all over his skin. A little servant girl said, “There’s a prophet who can help you!” So Naaman traveled to find Elisha.
Elisha sent a simple message: “Go wash in the river seven times.” Naaman was upset! “That’s too easy. Why didn’t he do something fancy?” He almost went home still sick.
But his servants said kindly, “Just try it!” So Naaman dipped in the river — one, two, three, four, five, six, seven times. When he came up, his skin was all better! He was completely healed.

Sometimes Heavenly Father asks us to do simple things. They might seem too easy, but obeying brings big blessings. Naaman learned to be humble and obey. Doing the small things God asks really matters.
